commands.table: Table for a list of records

editor.hint: Narrow Markdown, no HTML. Type {{open}} to insert a value.

sender.label: Sender
sender.none: No sender can be used in this base. Organization admins add and verify sender identities in Settings › Sender identities.
sender.systemOff: The organization turned the system sender off. Choose a sender identity.
sender.missing: The chosen sender can no longer be used (not verified, turned off or outside this base). Choose another one.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.placeholder: Add an email, a field or a person
recipients.pickFor: Choose a field or a person for {{label}}

replyTo.label: Reply-To
replyTo.clickedBy: The person who clicked the button
replyTo.runAs: The person the automation runs as
replyTo.unknown: A value that can no longer be used
replyTo.hint: Reply-To is only a verified sender identity or the email of a Cellhive user.

mayNotRead.title: Recipients may not be allowed to read some of this email.
mayNotRead.body: Email does not check what recipients may read: they get the whole content. See the checks under the preview.

subject.label: Subject
subject.hint: Plain text, one line, at most 255 characters.

body.label: Body
body.imageNeedsSave: Save the automation first: its images are stored with it.
body.tooManyImages_one: An email has at most {{count, number}} image.
body.tooManyImages_other: An email has at most {{count, number}} images.

digest.toggle: Insert the records an earlier step found
digest.hint: One line per record of a “Find records” step, where the body shows the chip “List of records”.
digest.missingStep: A step that no longer exists
digest.rowHint: Only the fields the step returns. Past the limit, one line says how many more there are.

signature.label: Include signature
signature.identity: The signature of the identity {{name}}. Organization admins edit it in Sender identities.

footer.label: Footer

lock.system: Emails from the system sender always have a footer.
lock.on_behalf: Emails sent on behalf always have a footer.
lock.policy: The organization requires a footer. “None” needs a policy that allows it and a verified identity that sends directly.
lock.none: “None” is allowed: the email is sent directly by a verified identity.
lock.unknown: “None” needs a policy that allows it and a verified identity that sends directly.

footer.tightenedBody: Emails get the minimal footer until you choose another option and save.

attachments.title: Attachments from file fields of the trigger record
attachments.noRecord: This trigger has no record, so there are no files to attach.
attachments.none: The trigger table has no attachment field.
attachments.onMissing: File not ready or being scanned
attachments.leaves: The files will be sent outside Cellhive.
attachments.blocked: No .html, .svg, .exe or other extensions Gmail blocks.

errors.attachment_access_denied: the automation cannot download some files
errors.attachment_not_ready: a file is not ready yet (uploading or being scanned)

smtp.title: The email server is not set up.
smtp.body: The operator needs to set SMTP_URL and SMTP_FROM. Organization admins see the status in Settings › Email.

preview.title: Preview

blocked.not_saved: Create the automation first: the preview and the test email use the saved automation (with your unsaved changes).
blocked.incomplete: Add a recipient and a subject to see the preview.
blocked.no_records: The trigger table has no record you can read to preview with.

preview.invalid: The preview cannot be built yet:
preview.sandbox: Isolated frame (sandbox, no scripts). Rendered by the server with your permissions.
preview.textNote: The text/plain part comes from the same Markdown tree: links become “text (url)”, tables become lines with |.
preview.onBehalfBody: The address is not in a domain sent directly, so From is the system address with “(via Cellhive)” and replies go to the identity. This keeps DMARC valid.

regex.title: {{name}} cannot be used in an email.
regex.hint: Create a formula field using REGEX in the table, then insert that field into the email.

test.limited: Sent {{max}} tests in one minute. Try again in {{seconds}} s.

failed.auth_failed: The email server refused the sign-in.
failed.host_not_allowed: The server of this identity is not allowed.
failed.tls_failed: The secure connection to the email server failed.
failed.connection_failed: Cannot connect to the email server.
failed.timeout: The email server did not answer in time.
failed.temporary: The email server is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
failed.rejected: The email server refused the email.
failed.unknown: The test email could not be sent.
failed.smtp_not_configured: The email server is not set up.
failed.smtp_temporary: The email server is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
failed.smtp_rejected: The email server refused the email.
failed.email_quota_exceeded: The organization reached its email limit for this hour.
failed.invalid_sender: The sender is not allowed by the email server settings.

checks.title: Checks with the sample record
checks.mayNotRead: Some recipients may not be allowed to read: {{fields}}
checks.mayNotReadRecord: Some recipients may not be allowed to read this record
checks.onBehalf: Sent on behalf: recipients see “(via Cellhive)”
checks.attachmentsUnavailable: The files cannot be sent with this record: {{reason}}
checks.render_one: {{count, number}} value could not be filled (empty in the email)
checks.render_other: {{count, number}} values could not be filled (empty in the email)

notification.recipientsHint: At most {{max}} people once groups are expanded.
notification.title: Title
notification.bodyHint: Plain text: no Markdown, no HTML. Line breaks are kept.
notification.skipActor: Leave out the person who caused the event
notification.skipActorHint: Off: they are notified too (e.g. a reminder to themselves).
notification.permissions: People who cannot read the record or a field used in the text do not receive it; the run history lists them.
